standardize.en: The school plans to standardize the format used for project reports.
standardize.zh: 學校計畫統一專題報告使用的格式。

standpoint.en: From a student's standpoint, the new schedule is easier to follow.
standpoint.zh: 從學生的立場來看，新時程更容易遵循。

static.en: The image remained static while the rest of the page changed.
static.zh: 頁面其他部分改變時，這張圖片保持不動。

steward.en: A steward welcomed passengers and answered questions during the journey.
steward.zh: 旅途中，一位服務人員迎接乘客並回答問題。

stoop.en: You may need to stoop slightly to enter the old doorway.
stoop.zh: 進入那道老門時，你可能需要稍微彎腰。

streak.en: A bright streak of light crossed the evening sky.
streak.zh: 一道明亮的光劃過傍晚天空。

streetcar.en: The historic streetcar still carries visitors through the city center.
streetcar.zh: 這輛歷史悠久的電車仍載著遊客穿越市中心。

substantially.en: The revised design substantially reduced the amount of wasted material.
substantially.zh: 修正版設計大幅減少了材料浪費。

suffering.en: The novel portrays the suffering caused by poverty without graphic detail.
suffering.zh: 小說描寫貧困造成的苦難，但沒有血腥細節。

sugarcane.en: The farm grows sugarcane in several fields near the river.
sugarcane.zh: 農場在河邊的幾塊田地種植甘蔗。

summer.en: The science camp will run for two weeks this summer.
summer.zh: 今年夏天科學營將舉辦兩週。

sunday.en: The community library closes earlier on sunday than on weekdays.
sunday.zh: 社區圖書館星期日比平日更早關門。

sunlight.en: Morning sunlight filled the classroom through the large windows.
sunlight.zh: 晨間陽光透過大窗戶灑滿教室。

sunset.en: We reached the viewpoint just before sunset.
sunset.zh: 我們在日落前不久抵達觀景點。

sunshine.en: Warm sunshine made the school courtyard pleasant during lunch break.
sunshine.zh: 溫暖陽光讓午休時的校園中庭很舒適。

superfluous.en: The editor removed superfluous details to make the paragraph clearer.
superfluous.zh: 編輯刪除多餘細節，讓段落更清楚。

superhighway.en: The new superhighway shortened travel time between the two cities.
superhighway.zh: 新的高速公路縮短了兩座城市之間的交通時間。

superimpose.en: The software can superimpose labels on the map for comparison.
superimpose.zh: 這套軟體可以把標籤疊加在地圖上以便比較。

surprising.en: The experiment produced a surprising result that prompted more questions.
surprising.zh: 實驗得到令人驚訝的結果，也引發更多問題。

syllabus.en: The teacher posted the course syllabus before the first class.
syllabus.zh: 老師在第一堂課前公布了課程大綱。

synthesis.en: The report requires a synthesis of ideas from several sources.
synthesis.zh: 這份報告需要整合多個來源的觀點。

systematically.en: The team systematically checked each part of the machine.
systematically.zh: 團隊有系統地檢查機器的每一個部分。

tablespoon.en: The recipe calls for one tablespoon of sugar.
tablespoon.zh: 這份食譜需要一大匙糖。

tabloid.en: The media class compared a tabloid headline with a news report.
tabloid.zh: 媒體課比較了小報標題與新聞報導。

taboo.en: The discussion explored why some topics become taboo in certain societies.
taboo.zh: 討論探討為何有些主題在特定社會中成為禁忌。

tally.en: The final tally showed that the proposal received enough votes.
tally.zh: 最後計票顯示該提案獲得足夠票數。

tangible.en: The project produced tangible improvements in the school garden.
tangible.zh: 這項計畫為校園花園帶來了明顯改善。

tanker.en: A large tanker passed the harbor during the geography field trip.
tanker.zh: 地理校外教學時，一艘大型油輪駛過港口。

tariff.en: The economics lesson explains how a tariff can affect imported goods.
tariff.zh: 經濟課說明關稅如何影響進口商品。

telegram.en: The museum displays an old telegram sent during the early twentieth century.
telegram.zh: 博物館展示一封二十世紀初寄出的舊電報。

temperament.en: The novel describes each character's temperament through everyday choices.
temperament.zh: 小說透過日常選擇描寫每個角色的性情。

tempest.en: The play uses a powerful tempest to begin the story.
tempest.zh: 這齣戲以一場猛烈暴風雨作為故事開端。

ten.en: Ten students volunteered to help organize the reading event.
ten.zh: 有十名學生自願協助籌辦閱讀活動。

tern.en: A tern circled above the shore before landing on a rock.
tern.zh: 一隻燕鷗在岸邊上空盤旋後停在岩石上。

terrified.en: The character felt terrified during the storm but stayed with the group.
terrified.zh: 角色在暴風雨中感到害怕，但仍和團隊待在一起。

theatrical.en: The club used theatrical lighting to make the school play more dramatic.
theatrical.zh: 社團使用舞台燈光讓校內戲劇更有張力。

theologian.en: The history text quotes a theologian discussing ideas from that period.
theologian.zh: 歷史課本引用一位神學家對當時思想的討論。

theological.en: The library contains several theological works from different traditions.
theological.zh: 圖書館收藏來自不同傳統的多本神學著作。

thermal.en: The science class measured thermal changes during the experiment.
thermal.zh: 自然科學課測量實驗過程中的熱變化。

thirteen.en: Thirteen teams entered the competition before registration closed.
thirteen.zh: 報名截止前共有十三支隊伍參賽。

thirty.en: The presentation lasted thirty minutes including the question period.
thirty.zh: 這場簡報包含問答時間共持續三十分鐘。

thrift.en: The lesson linked thrift with careful planning and responsible spending.
thrift.zh: 課堂把節儉與謹慎規劃及負責任的花費連結起來。

thrilling.en: The final race was thrilling because the result stayed uncertain.
thrilling.zh: 最後一場比賽非常刺激，因為結果一直不確定。

thunderstorm.en: The outdoor event moved inside when a thunderstorm approached.
thunderstorm.zh: 雷雨接近時，戶外活動移到室內。

thursday.en: The science club meets every thursday after school.
thursday.zh: 科學社每個星期四放學後聚會。

tightly.en: The lid was tightly closed before the box was moved.
tightly.zh: 箱子移動前，蓋子已緊緊關好。

totally.en: The revised ending was totally different from the first draft.
totally.zh: 修正版結尾和初稿完全不同。

touchstone.en: Fairness became a touchstone for evaluating the new school policy.
touchstone.zh: 公平成為評估新校規的重要標準。

tractor.en: A tractor moved slowly across the field during our visit.
tractor.zh: 參訪時，一輛拖拉機慢慢駛過田野。

tranquil.en: The garden remained tranquil despite the busy street nearby.
tranquil.zh: 儘管附近街道繁忙，花園仍然十分寧靜。
